records.subject: Welcome aboard, Quartz Partners
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Your CSV export ticket — and a quick next step
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for flagging that your CSV export is missing the last column compared to what's shown on screen. That ticket is open with our support team, and I'm keeping an eye on it with them so it doesn't sit.

In the meantime, you've got your first project set up in Wrenfield, and projects are the main organizing unit with tasks living inside them. If it would help, I'm happy to jump on a short call this week to walk through what you're trying to get out of Wrenfield and sort out the export question alongside it.

Best,
Nadia
